charge_port.notes: US: InsideEVs says the 2026 i5 M60 was the only 2026 i5 with a Tesla-style port before March 2026 builds.
Canada (estimated): BMW Canada says built-in NACS is only on all-new 2026+ models (iX3, i3); no Canadian i5 page found, CCS1 assumed. Unproven.

supercharger_access.notes: Canada: Lectron Vortex Plus adapter plus software update (from 2026-04-08) for CCS cars.

wheels.notes: M60 Sedan: 19 x 8.5 front / 19 x 10 rear aluminum, P245/45R19 and P275/40R19; no optional wheels listed. (US page; Canadian cars assumed the same.)
